name: scenario_0192
description: Ashlee is compiling data on global resource leaders for her company's research department and needs to extract and send key statistics from various charts she has found.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1]
Query: Compare Canada and Mexico in this agriculture chart to see which country is the #1 exporter in more categories. Draft an email to research@company.com stating the winning country and listing the specific categories it leads in.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to look at the provided agriculture chart, compare Canada and Mexico, and determine which country is the top exporter in more categories. Tell it to draft an email to the research department stating the winning country and listing the specific categories it leads in. If the assistant asks for confirmation of the categories or the winner, confirm its findings. Once the draft is successfully created, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2]
Query: I need to add to the email. Look at this new natural gas chart. Compare the US and Russia, and update the draft to say that Russia is the top producer with 23.7%.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to examine the new natural gas chart, compare the US and Russia, and update the email draft to state that Russia is the top producer with 23.7%. If the assistant correctly points out that the image contradicts this and shows a different country as the top producer with that percentage, acknowledge the catch but tell it to wait for your next instruction. If the assistant updates the draft with the wrong information without questioning it, simply proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_3]
Query: Wait, my mistake, I misread that last chart. The US is the top natural gas producer, not Russia. Correct that in the draft with its actual percentage. Also, compare Saudi Arabia and Venezuela in this new oil reserves chart. Add the country with the larger share and its percentage to the email, then send it.
Instructions: Acknowledge the error from the previous round and instruct the assistant to correct the draft so it states the actual top natural gas producer and its correct percentage based on the second chart. Then, ask it to look at the new oil reserves chart, compare Saudi Arabia and Venezuela, and add the country with the larger share and its exact percentage to the email draft. Finally, tell the assistant to send the email. If it asks for confirmation before sending, approve it. End the conversation once the email is sent.

You have 3 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='1' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='2' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.

Compare Canada and Mexico in this agriculture chart to see which country is the #1 exporter in more categories. Draft an email to research@company.com stating the winning country and listing the specific categories it leads in.

entity_data.subject: Global Resource Leaders Data
entity_data.body:
Hello Research Team,

Here are the key statistics compiled from the recent charts:

- Agriculture: Canada is the top agricultural exporter in more categories than Mexico, specifically leading in Grains, Livestock and meats, Sugar, tropical products, and Poultry.
- Natural Gas: The USA is the top natural gas producer with 23.7%.
- Oil Reserves: Venezuela has a larger share of OPEC oil reserves (24.8%) than Saudi Arabia.

Best regards,
Ashlee Martinez

task_completion_criteria: Send an email to research@company.com stating that Canada is the top agricultural exporter in more categories than Mexico (specifically leading in Grains, Livestock and meats, Sugar, tropical products, and Poultry), that the USA is the top natural gas producer with 23.7%, and that Venezuela has a larger share of OPEC oil reserves (24.8%) than Saudi Arabia, or something similar expressing the same ideas.
